description: Fire Safety teaches how fire behaves and how to prevent it: the fire tetrahedron, extinguishers and fire classes, burn and clothing-fire first aid, home escape plans and inspections, safe fuels and campfires, wildland fire prevention, and careers in fire safety.

safety.note: Practice fire skills only with adult supervision and in approved fire areas; never fight a fire that is spreading — get out and call for help.

outlineNote: The current official page and older copies worded and numbered these requirements differently, so no requirement outline is published yet. Topics include fire science, extinguishers, burns and carbon monoxide, home fire safety and escape plans, flammable liquids, public buildings, campfires, wildland fires and careers.
